title: Keep tracking accuracy and work accuracy at their actual rates
statement: The accepted stopped-moment/true-current work calculation gives O(N^2+NK_N) signed mean carrier-force work, and cN sum_y(v_y^A)^2-o(N^2) for sustained row transport. Deterministic O(1/K_N) observation bias can itself consume O(N^2); merely vanishing bias suffices for tracking only. Full held force must be measurable at the start of the previous block. The result prices carrier force rather than total apparatus work.

requires: Actual fixed rows, nonlinear translation-invariant relative mechanics, independent local positional jitter with exp(CN^2) density ceiling
Growing stiffness, its actual sublevel force/derivative envelope and joint fresh thermal sources across rows/carriers/periods
Declared smoothed computable spatial target, joint error/cap/timing interfaces and supplied native volume-speed LDP

assumptions: Only the row-mean horizontal flow is programmed; vertical and zero-row-mean native currents remain. S is actual analytic smoothing; nonlinear composition in the unsmoothed weak topology can fail. Joint conditional product thermal sources, common-within-row kinetics, positive response, previous-block-old commands and the corrected force cap are binding. A native LDP is a separate input. No order-volume complete instrument budget or final external pointer reader is established.
costs: N^2 added charges in both reference/deployment; stiffness and initial precision are paid
Logarithmic stiffness can require conservative rare-tail frequency O(N^3 sqrt(log N)), beyond typical frequency
Mean carrier-force work O(N^2+NK_N) at actual O(1/K_N) deterministic bias; O(N^4) fresh thermal coordinates and complete reader costs remain
